sourceDocument: Master Research Source Directory(3).odt; registered candidate catalog

entries.title: Momentum whipsaw in a narrow price window
entries.reviewFocus: Constrain momentum-whipsaw interpretation to completed bars and explicitly defined observation windows.

entries.title: Day Trading: What It Is and What It Is Not — The defining boundary
entries.reviewFocus: Explain day-trading session and open-close boundaries without confusing risk exposure with investment holding periods.

entries.title: Day Trading: What It Is and What It Is Not — What day trading demands
entries.reviewFocus: Connect capital, discipline, time constraints, order management and risk to the realistic burdens of day trading.

entries.title: Day Trading: What It Is and What It Is Not — What the Day Trader Actually Controls
entries.reviewFocus: Distinguish controllable order inputs and maximum planned risk from uncontrollable prices, liquidity and fills.

entries.title: How a Day Trade Actually Works — From idea to qualified opportunity
entries.reviewFocus: Separate a researched candidate and a qualified conditional setup from an automatic trade signal.

entries.title: How a Day Trade Actually Works — Management begins at entry
entries.reviewFocus: Connect entries to explicit exit, invalidation and order-state evaluation rather than unverified fills.

entries.title: How a Day Trade Actually Works — Stage 2 — Build the Thesis in Conditional Language
entries.reviewFocus: Create conditional if/then trade hypotheses without suggesting future information was available in advance.

entries.title: The Trading Day — Premarket
entries.reviewFocus: Teach premarket session, quote/volume coverage, liquidity limitations and official trading-hours context.

entries.title: The Trading Day — Midday
entries.reviewFocus: Describe reduced midday participation as an observed variable, not a universal or guaranteed market regime.

entries.title: The Trading Day — 9:30-10:00 a.m. ET: Price Discovery and Compression of Decisions
entries.reviewFocus: Distinguish 9:30–10:00 a.m. ET price discovery, opening auctions and evidence-based decision constraints.

entries.title: Accounts, Buying Power, Settlement, and Day-Trading Restrictions — Margin accounts and the 2026 transition
entries.reviewFocus: REQUIRES CURRENT REGULATORY REVIEW: verify effective dates and controlling day-trading margin/settlement provisions before publishing any 2026 transition statement.

entries.title: Accounts, Buying Power, Settlement, and Day-Trading Restrictions — Buying power and house requirements
entries.reviewFocus: REQUIRES CURRENT BROKER/RULE REVIEW: separate available buying power, borrowing, broker house margin and possible liquidation risk.

entries.title: Accounts, Buying Power, Settlement, and Day-Trading Restrictions — Margin Accounts: Buying Power Is a Credit and Risk Function
entries.reviewFocus: REQUIRES CURRENT REGULATORY REVIEW: credit versus cash, collateral, interest, maintenance rules and liquidation risk.

entries.title: Risk Comes Before Profit — Risk per trade
entries.reviewFocus: Define risk per share using entry/invalidation distance and distinguish planned risk from actual slip-adjusted loss.

entries.title: Risk Comes Before Profit — Reward does not erase risk
entries.reviewFocus: Calculate expectancy with consistent win/loss units and acknowledge loss tails, commissions and model uncertainty.

entries.title: Risk Comes Before Profit — Add Execution Risk to the Model
entries.reviewFocus: Distinguish spread, depth, fill uncertainty, slippage and venue conditions in realistic execution risk.

entries.title: Building Your Day-Trading Laboratory — Freeze the workspace
entries.reviewFocus: Freeze a reproducible replay workspace, timestamp, symbol, visible completed bars and setup inputs.

entries.title: Building Your Day-Trading Laboratory — Use progressive reveal
entries.reviewFocus: Use strictly progressive completed-bar reveal with hidden future history and no outcome-informed hints.

entries.title: Building Your Day-Trading Laboratory — Set the Historical Clock Before Looking at the Chart
entries.reviewFocus: Record market/session timezone and replay pause time before chart display or lesson decision.

entries.title: Intraday Price Action and Market Structure — Higher highs and higher lows
entries.reviewFocus: Mark confirmed higher swing highs and lows using completed pivot evidence without future-bar pivot labeling.
